gaps.sentence: He loves showing ___ his new car to the neighbours.
gaps.explanation: show off = try to impress people with your abilities/possessions.

gaps.sentence: We saw our guests ___ at the station.
gaps.explanation: see somebody off = go with a traveller to say goodbye.

gaps.sentence: The concert tickets sold ___ within an hour.
gaps.explanation: sell out = all tickets/goods are sold.

gaps.sentence: The doctors pulled him ___ after a difficult night.
gaps.explanation: pull through = recover from a serious illness.

gaps.sentence: Do come round ___ dinner next week.
gaps.explanation: come round = visit; come round FOR dinner/TO our place.

gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: He ended ___ selling insurance, though he'd trained as a chef.
gaps.explanation: end up = finally be in a place/situation/state.

gaps.sentence: She's been going ___ a difficult time at work.
